links.comparator_used: Clinician-only drafting from scratch using matched templates (unedited LLM-only drafts also analyzed)
links.outcome: Document creation time (primary) and expert-rated document quality (secondary) for discharge summaries and referrals
links.effect: Summaries: clinician-in-the-loop β = −59.4 seconds (95% CI −118.1 to −0.8; P = .047). Referrals: β = +94.8 seconds (95% CI 40.4 to 149.3; P<.001). Quality was higher with clinician-in-the-loop in most domains for both document types. LLM-only drafts were fastest but had the lowest quality.
links.tradeoff: Referrals took longer with the LLM-assisted workflow (+94.8 seconds). Unedited LLM drafts were the lowest quality.
links.quote: For summaries, Clinician-in-the-loop was associated with shorter creation time versus Clinician-only (β = −59.4 seconds; 95% CI, −118.1 to −0.8; P = .047).

design_hint: clinician review and editing of LLM drafts
